official_reference_pages.label: WHO Child Growth Standards 2006: published standards and original LMS data

pending_clearance_details: 14 WHO reference tables include 30 additional days each outside anthro R. Website-specific authorization remains outstanding for 420 rows.

r_package.copyright_holder: World Health Organization (as declared in R package DESCRIPTION)
r_package.name: anthro

r_package_usage_and_packaging_basis: WHO's own GPL-3 anthro R package provides an independent software/data reference: its embedded coefficient arrays were compared record-by-record, its implementation defines relevant methodological and clinical usage conventions, and its source distribution informed provenance and file attribution. The pedgrowth LMS packaging format and Python algorithms were independently implemented.
scientific_values_origin: The values are derived from WHO Child Growth Standards 2006 official downloadable coefficient tables, normalized into age/sex-specific LMS CSVs and independently compiled into LMS binaries. The official WHO anthro R package embeds matching LMS values for its covered age domain: 28,228 LMS records match across WHO 2006/2007 combined, with no mismatches, but 420 WHO 2006 records in the pedgrowth source files fall outside the anthro package's reference age domain.

validation.independent_oracle: WHO-authored anthro R 1.1.0 embedded LMS coefficients and independently computed R z-scores
validation.input_origin: WHO 2006 official downloadable LMS tables, checked by source SHA-256 and normalized CSV SHA-256
validation.limitations: WHO R has a shorter computational age domain than some WHO downloadable table rows; only independently covered values are considered numerically cross-validated.
